settings: Larger zone memory at 8 GB and the precise FPS limit, as the stack's owner plays it
how: tools/dev/session/map-check.ps1 -Live, one game per map: Xerces.exe launches the stack, the map is started from the console, the check waits for the player in the level, plays 30 s with the intro skipped, captures the screen, goes back to the menu and quits; a crash, a freeze, an error box or the time running out ends the run. Steam Workshop maps as installed on the test PC; The Giant from the DLC is not on it.
